problem.statement: Garnet has committed Wasm run, check, and capability-diff adapters plus a hermetic package probe, but it cannot honestly claim a browser-live playground until committed package bytes, real page integration, fail-closed denial, and reproducible browser evidence exist together.
successCriteria: A clean browser loads only committed package bytes and renders real run, check, and capability-diff results without a network fetch or Node-only execution path
A browser attempt to use denied process authority rejects with a non-success exit class and a visible diagnostic
Two clean builds from the same committed inputs produce byte-identical browser package files and provenance
The readiness reporter promotes browser status only after validating the committed package and browser proof
Capability diff renders a one-glance human verdict and a versioned structured machine verdict from the same adapter result

definitionOfDone.claim: a real browser can run, check, and capability-diff Garnet source from the committed package
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: a clean-browser Playwright run that loads only committed package bytes must produce run + check + diff output; any Node-only path, any network fetch, or any uncommitted artifact falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: a denied capability fails closed in the browser
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: the denial flow must reject and surface the denial; a silent pass, a warning-only path, or a partial execution falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the browser package is reproducible from committed inputs
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: two clean builds must produce byte-identical package output; any divergence falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: browser readiness is evidence-backed rather than prose-promoted
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: remove, corrupt, or mismatch the committed browser proof or package; scripts/garnet_wasm_readiness.py --gate must fail

definitionOfDone.claim: diff-caps has one human verdict and one structured machine verdict
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: the browser proof must assert the visible expansion verdict and parse the versioned machine JSON; disagreement or missing fields falsifies

confidence.biggestRisk: A polished editor could accidentally certify a Node path, a warning-only denial, or package bytes that were not committed and reproducible.
confidence.nextAction: Record RED contract tests before materializing the browser package or wiring the live page.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Promote browser-live wording from the existing Node smoke and static gallery
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Neither surface proves a real browser journey or a fail-closed denial path.
